findings.detail: After staging, export creates destination before moving files. A mid-move filesystem failure can leave a partial destination that blocks retry. Existing content is not overwritten.
findings.suggestion: Rollback the just-created destination on failure, or publish a fully populated staged directory atomically where supported.
